action: from aiohttp import web import re async def decide_unsubscribe(request): # Extract the raw email from the request body raw_email = await request.text() # Extract the 'From' email address using a more robust regex from_match = re.search(r'From:\s*.*?<([^>]+)>', raw_email) if not from_match: return web.json_response({'error': 'Invalid email format'}, status=400) email_address = from_match.group(1) # Check for unsubscribe keywords unsubscribe_keywords = [ "unsubscribe", "remove me", "deregister me", "stop sending me", "delete me" ] unsubscribe = any(keyword in raw_email.lower() for keyword in unsubscribe_keywords) # Return the decision return web.json_response({ 'email': email_address, 'unsubscribe': unsubscribe }) app = web.Application() app.router.add_post('/decideUnsubscribe', decide_unsubscribe) if __name__ == '__main__': web.run_app(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
